records.text: A marsh oracle among the coastal fish men hunted in the Swamp of Sorrows. Katar asks adventurers to fight these oracles alongside marsh inkspewers and flesheaters.
Swamp Talker is the murloc Bengor names as having seized the Warchief’s Orders during an ambush on the way to the Blasted Lands. Bengor places Swamp Talker in a cave to the east.
Bernie Heisten sells food and drink in the Swamp of Sorrows. His goods are available through the local vendor service.

Watcher Mahar Ba is a researcher in Nethergarde Keep who sought Khadgar’s Essays on Dimensional Convergence from Master Mazen. When the essay reaches him, he says he can begin his research at once and is excited to study Khadgar’s work.

Quartermaster Lungertz is a quartermaster at Nethergarde Keep who receives supply deliveries. The deliveries described for him include powerstones for the mages and recovered or replacement supplies; his replies mention losses along the route from Darkshire and a dwindling stock of Azoran Crystals.
Strumner Flintheel is Nethergarde Keep’s armorer. He offers goods to browse and provides a repair service.
Dreadmaul Ogres are hostile ogres encountered in the Blasted Lands. They shout blunt threats about smashing or crushing opponents; they also use an attack spell.
Dreadmaul Ogre Mages are hostile ogres encountered in the Blasted Lands. They use the same blunt smashing and crushing threats as other Dreadmaul ogres, and they use Fireball.
Dreadmaul Brutes are hostile ogres encountered in the Blasted Lands. They use the same blunt smashing and crushing threats as other Dreadmaul ogres, and they use an attack spell.
Dreadmaul Mauler uses blunt taunts, roaring and threatening to smash or crush its opponent.
Dreadmaul Warlock shares the blunt Dreadmaul taunts, threatening to smash or crush an opponent. In combat, it casts Shadow Bolt.
Wretched Lost One uses Immolate and Enfeeble in combat.
Black Slayer is a beast that uses Execute against a target at 0–20% health.
Bonepicker is a beast that casts Fevered Fatigue on a target at 0–20% health.
Starving Snickerfang is a hungry beast.
Snickerfang Hyenas are beasts found in the Blasted Lands. They are wild predators.
Scorpok Stingers are creatures found in several parts of the Blasted Lands. They use Venom Sting when fighting, fitting their dangerous scorpion nature.
Redstone Basilisks are creatures found in the Blasted Lands. In combat, they cast Crystal Gaze, a threat associated with their basilisk identity.
Redstone Crystalhides are creatures found across parts of the Blasted Lands. They use Crystal Flash in combat.
Ashmane Boars are creatures found in the Blasted Lands. They can cast Fire Shield outside combat.

Helboars are creatures hunted in the Blasted Lands. The Fallen Hero of the Horde describes killing one as a test of strength and invokes Rexxar's example; Helboars fight with Fire Nova and a rushing charge.
A humanoid Nethergarde soldier, found in the Nethergarde area.
A humanoid cleric found among Nethergarde's forces.
A humanoid Nethergarde analyst found in the Nethergarde area.
A humanoid Nethergarde riftwatcher found in the Nethergarde area.
A humanoid officer found among Nethergarde's forces.
A Shadowsworn cultist found in the Blasted Lands, one of the targets in the Fallen Hero of the Horde's call for retribution against the Shadowsworn.
A Shadowsworn combatant found across several parts of the Blasted Lands. Its recorded combat actions include Kick, Snap Kick and Thrash.

A Shadowsworn Adept encountered in the Blasted Lands, where its kindred appear across multiple areas. It uses Blood Leech in combat and is named among the targets in the Fallen Hero of the Horde’s War on the Shadowsworn.
A Shadowsworn Enforcer found in the Blasted Lands. Its combat action is Cleave, marking it as a direct melee threat among the scattered Shadowsworn.
A Shadowsworn Warlock found in the Blasted Lands. Its recorded behavior includes summoning a Voidwalker while out of combat, giving it a means of bringing demonic support into a fight.
A Shadowsworn Dreadweaver encountered in the Blasted Lands. Its recorded combat action is Shadow Bolt, identifying it as a ranged magical threat among the local Shadowsworn.
A Felhound found in the Blasted Lands, specifically recorded in area 72. It uses Mana Burn in combat, a distinctive magical attack for this demonic beast.
A Felguard Sentry found in the Blasted Lands, specifically recorded in area 72. It uses Cleave in combat, fitting its role as a guard that threatens nearby opponents.

Kum'isha is a Draenei exile whose homecoming depends on finding flawless Draenethyst spheres. He recruits travelers to collect them, offering riches while mocking the greed that he says displaced him. Imperfect fragments may serve other uses, though he doubts they can bring him home. His goal is to reopen a path to Outland for his brethren.
A Deadwind mauler is a combatant encountered in Deadwind Pass and nearby Deadwind areas. It attacks with an uppercut.
A Deadwind warlock is a combatant encountered in Deadwind Pass and nearby Deadwind areas. It attacks with shadow bolt.

Bloodmage Drazial studies the unusual physical traits of the Blasted Lands’ beasts, which he believes were changed by energy released when the Dark Portal opened. He investigates their strength, stamina, and agility, seeking to turn those qualities into elixirs and assays. His research ranges from snickerfang jaw strength to boar resilience and scorpok agility; he shares samples with assistants and keeps some for further study.

Bloodmage Lynnore studies the cerebral and spiritual qualities of the Blasted Lands’ wildlife, a different focus from her brother Drazial’s work on their physical traits. She describes redstone basilisks as unusually intelligent and investigates their brains, while also studying spiritual effects and regenerative abilities. Her research uses wildlife components to prepare compounds that she offers to assistants.

Grol the Destroyer is one of the triad adventurers are sent to defeat on the way to the Defiler, and the Amulet of Grol is a piece to recover. Grol uses Ground Smash and Knock Away; Fel Curse can remove his invincibility.

Archmage Allistarj is one of the triad adventurers are sent to defeat on the way to the Defiler, and the Amulet of Allistarj is a piece to recover. Allistarj casts Frost Armor out of combat and Fireball in combat.

Lady Sevine is one of the triad adventurers are sent to defeat on the way to the Defiler, and the Amulet of Sevine is a piece to recover. Sevine casts Frost Armor out of combat and Shadow Bolt in combat.

Servants of Razelikh are souls held in Stones of Binding, released when a stone shatters. The quest asks adventurers to free them from Razelikh’s forces, and a servant’s line asks that regards be given to Commander Trebor.

Servants of Grol are souls held in Stones of Binding, released when a stone shatters. The quest asks adventurers to free them among those held by Razelikh’s forces, and a servant’s line asks that regards be given to Commander Trebor.
A soul bound to a Stone of Binding, the Servant of Allistarj is freed when the stone shatters and asks that Commander Trebor receive its regards.
A soul bound to a Stone of Binding, the Servant of Sevine is freed when the stone shatters and asks that Commander Trebor receive its regards.
Kirith the Damned is a lone Blasted Lands adversary whose combat techniques include Pierce Armor and Mana Burn.

Lieutenant Kirith was imprisoned and tortured by Allistarj, though Commander Trebor feared his will had failed and believed him lost. As a spirit, Kirith explains that each of Razelikh's three underlings wears a fragment of the amulet needed to summon the demon lord, then directs the adventurer back to Trebor.

Ambassador Ardalan is a quest-giving envoy in the Blasted Lands. His appeal argues that fighting over scorched ground is futile while the Burning Legion grows stronger, and directs the player to consult the Fallen Hero of the Horde, who knows the truth behind the region.
Teremus the Devourer is a elite dragon. In combat he uses Flame Breath, Cleave, Knock Away, and Soul Consumption.
A Nethergarde Elite is an elite humanoid found in the Blasted Lands.

Thadius Grimshade bargains to find the gryphon Sharpbeak in exchange for Nekrum Gutchewer's medallion, which he wants to study for its rumored longevity-giving power while avoiding its side effects. He uses a feather in a divination ritual to trace Sharpbeak to Jintha'Alor, then sends the seeker onward to free him.
Nina Lightbrew sells alchemy supplies and invites visitors to browse the goods.
Mojo the Twisted is an elite humanoid. He casts Shadow Bolt and Shadow Bolt Volley, including a volley when targets are within range.
Magronos the Unyielding is an elite humanoid. His combat actions include Cleave and Hamstring, and he can go into a frenzy. Those cues give him a forceful combat presence.
Akubar the Seer is an elite humanoid. His combat spells are Lightning Bolt, Slow and Chain Lightning. The title marks him as a seer.
Spiteflayer is an elite beast. It uses Curse of Blood, giving this named creature a dangerous magical attack.
Ravage is an elite beast. It uses Poison and Infected Bite.
Clack the Reaver is an elite beast. His combat abilities include Venom Sting and Knockdown.
Deatheye is a powerful beast. In combat, it uses Crystal Gaze and can call upon Call of the Grave when wounded.
Grunter is a powerful beast whose combat style includes a Berserker Charge and Tendon Rip.
Dreadscorn is a formidable creature that fights with Strike and Backhand, and can unleash Bloodlust when badly wounded.
Alexandra Constantine is a gryphon master. Travelers can ask her where they can fly.
Felbeast is a creature that uses Mana Burn in combat.
Dreadlord is a combatant whose attacks include Mind Blast, Psychic Scream, and Sleep.
Felguard Elite is an elite combatant that uses Cleave.
Manahound is a combatant whose attacks include Mana Burn and Tendon Rip.
The Deathly Usher describes itself as eternally bound to this cursed world. It can send a mortal who wishes to face the Defiler to Razelikh.
Enohar Thunderbrew is a dwarf serving in Nethergarde. She says the post can feel stuffy and that a brew helps take her mind off her duty.
The Doomguard Commander is a battle-ready demon that uses Rain of Fire in combat.

Daio the Decrepit directs a multi-stage effort to build a crystal prison for a Doomguard. He explains how Wildspawn blood suppresses the demon's magical defenses and binds Hederine crystals into the casing, then warns that capturing a commander is dangerous enough to warrant companions. After the materials are recovered, he prepares the prison and says the captor is ready to learn to conjure and control the beast.

Elder Bellowrage is a named elder who speaks of the olden races and the awakening of the ancients when the year is new and the moon shines bright. In a quest reward, Bellowrage welcomes homage to the olden races and offers the visitor a token.
Advisor Sevel is a humanoid in the Blasted Lands.

Watch Commander Relthorn Netherwane recalls the Nethergarde and Argent Dawn’s desperate stand against a demonic assault, and regards the calm around the portal as deceptive because fierce fighting continues beyond it.

Warlord Dar'toon speaks of the renewed war against Outland’s demons as a grim duty and pleasure. He wistfully says he would have given an eye to witness the earlier clash at the portal, while describing fiercer fighting beyond it now.
Argent Dawn Agent Proudwell calls for help against the demonic assault at the breach and expresses gratitude to heroes who aid the order, whose light shines against the darkness.
The Blasted Lands Flame Warden is a festival attendant who invites visitors to honor the local flame, encourages them to visit fires in Alliance-settled lands, and disparages the Horde’s fires.

place_records.text: You are in the Blasted Lands, a scorched land of the Eastern Kingdoms. The Alliance holds a few places here, chiefly Nethergarde Keep, and no settlement of the Horde stands here. Dreadmaul ogres, shadowsworn cultists, felbeasts and basilisks roam the wastes.

You are in The Dark Portal, a gate in the Blasted Lands. Watch Commander Relthorn Netherwane of the Alliance says the calm here is deceptive, since fierce fighting continues beyond the portal. Warlord Dar'toon of the Horde speaks of the renewed war against Outland's demons as a grim duty. A spirit healer is here, and helboar, felguard sentries and felhounds prowl the ground.

You are in The Tainted Scar, a part of the Blasted Lands. Daio the Decrepit is building a crystal prison for a Doomguard, and he warns that capturing a commander is dangerous. Felguard elites, manahounds, Doomguard commanders and dreadlords roam the ground.

You are in Dreadmaul Hold, a hold in the Blasted Lands. Bloodmage Drazial and his sister Bloodmage Lynnore study the beasts here: he looks at their physical traits, and she looks at their minds and spirits. Drazial believes the beasts were changed by energy released when the Dark Portal opened. Dreadmaul ogres, ogre mages, scorpoks and starving snickerfangs roam here, and a spirit healer is also here.

You are in Nethergarde Keep, an Alliance keep in the Blasted Lands. Travelers find a gryphon master, an armorer for repairs, and vendors. Quartermaster Lungertz receives supplies here, and his replies mention losses along the route from Darkshire. Marsh oracles, marsh flesheaters, starving snickerfangs and scorpoks are among the dangers around it.
You are in Dreadmaul Post in the Blasted Lands. Dreadmaul maulers and warlocks, felbeasts and Servants of Grol are the dangers here, and Magronos the Unyielding and Clack the Reaver are among them.
You are in Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands. Shadowsworn cultists, thugs and adepts roam here, along with grunters, redstone basilisks and spiteflayers.
You are in Altar of Storms in the Blasted Lands. Shadowsworn enforcers, warlocks and dreadweavers roam here, and Lady Sevine, with her servants, is among the dangers.
You are in Garrison Armory in the Blasted Lands, an Alliance post where Nethergarde miners do mining work and Nethergarde foremen oversee it.

You are in Rise of the Defiler in the Blasted Lands. Kum'isha the Collector, a Draenei exile, recruits travelers to gather flawless draenethyst spheres for a return home, and offers riches for them. The Deathly Usher, eternally bound to this cursed world, can send a mortal who wishes to face the Defiler to Razelikh. Scorpoks, snickerfang hyenas, wretched lost ones and ravages are the dangers.
